title: Retire obsolete live validation routes
status_detail: serial R2.7 child; eligible only after repository-validation completion and explicit coordinator selection
objective: Remove the obsolete maintained identifier-audit CLI route and only proven-removable private route or shadow machinery while preserving public compatibility and historical records.
authorized_scope: Repeat exact maintained-consumer and public-contract scans immediately before deletion and update the retained retirement inventory.

Remove the identifier-audit CLI and command owner, make PythonConformanceValidator the sole repository-wide Python evidence gate, and synchronize current inventories, routing resources, agents, skills, tests, and operational documentation.
Delete only private route or shadow surfaces proven obsolete; retain, de-authoritize, deprecate, or block public compatibility surfaces according to accepted authority.
completion_criteria: Retired commands are absent from the live CLI inventory and no current skill, durable agent, or repository validator routes to them.
Retained public compatibility APIs still import and behave as documented, and no removable private operational route remains.
Historical evidence, checkpoints, archives, and immutable historical reports remain unchanged; control synchronization and affected deterministic validation pass.
exclusions: Do not infer external non-use from internal non-use, remove an unapproved public contract, or replace deleted machinery with another compatibility layer.
Do not rewrite historical records, add dependencies, change scientific code, or perform protected work.
